title: application-exception diagnostic report v5
description: A caught-object-report-json report object (corj/v0.14, https://github.com/dany-fedorov/caught-object-report-json) whose root carries occurrence_id, fingerprint, context, context_omitted, reporting_errors and reporting_errors_omitted, all of them corj's own fields. corj definitions are embedded under $defs; a missing corj field holds its expected value, null means producing it failed.

corjBase.description: Base properties shared by the root and every child report, as defined by corj/v0.14. The root-only properties are marked as such.

occurrence_id.description: Root only. Identifies this occurrence: the typed exception's occurrenceId, or a generated AE_ id. Shared with the public report.

fingerprint.description: Root only. Equal for failures of the same kind from the same place: fp1_ plus 32 hex characters, or a caller-supplied token. A retry signal, not a lookup key.

truncated.description: Present when content or child reports were omitted to meet the report size limit.

instanceof_error.description: Result of `caught instanceof Error`. Omitted when true.

constructor_name.description: Result of `caught.constructor.name`; null when reading it threw. Omitted with as_string and message when the first stack line is `constructor_name: message`.

message.description: Result of `caught.message`; null when reading it threw. Omitted as described for constructor_name.

as_string.description: String form of the caught value (`String(caught)`); null when producing it threw. Omitted when it equals the first stack line.

as_json.description: JSON form of the caught value's enumerable properties, cut with [truncated] markers under the size limit; null when producing it threw. Omitted when {}.

stack.description: Result of `caught.stack` split into lines (or the raw string with stackFormat "string"); null when reading it threw.

children_omitted.description: Present when this node has child sources that were not reported.

children_sources.description: Root only. Properties children were collected from. Omitted when ["cause", "errors"].

context.description: Root only. Caller data rendered as JSON; paths inside it start at $context.

context_omitted.description: Root only. The context was dropped to meet maxReportSize.

reporting_errors.description: Root only. Problems met while inspecting the caught value or the context, at most 8.

reporting_errors_omitted.description: Root only. The reporting errors were dropped to meet maxReportSize.

corjReportingError.description: One failure met while the report was produced. The same shape reaches the onError handler.

path.description: JSONPath of the value. $ is the caught root; $context and other named roots are separate documents.

key.description: The report field being produced, when there is one.

prop.description: The property of the caught object being read, when there is one.

error.description: Text describing the failure, scrubbed by the redaction policy and cut to 256 characters.

id.description: Node id within this report, from the makeReportId option. Not the occurrence id.

path.description: JSONPath from the root caught value, for example $.cause.errors[0].

level.description: Depth in the error tree; the root is 0.

child_ids.description: Ids of this node's direct children; a repeated object references its first id.

children.description: Every nested error found through children_sources, flattened breadth-first.

appexExtension.description: What application-exception requires of a corj report: the version it emits, and the occurrence id it always sets. Both are corj's own fields.

v.description: The corj report version. corj/v0.14-full marks a complete report, as produced by restoreExpectedValues or when corj could not omit expected values.
